_about: Labelled test set. Section ids refer to corpus documents (AR, EE, HH, FS, SF, LM). See corpus/CONTRADICTIONS.md for the planted conflicts.
_changelog: Three of the original 25 not_covered questions (N11 calculator, N18 hostel-fee dues, N24 exam-fee refund) turned out to be answerable on a strict reading: in each case the rulebook has a positive list or a general sentence that covers the item by omission or by generality. The models answered them from the right clause; the labels were the weak side of the argument. They were moved to the ungraded 'borderline' list below with the reasoning, and replaced with questions the corpus is genuinely silent on. Nothing else in this file changed after the first evaluation run.

agent_examples.question: My attendance is 58% because I was in hospital for three weeks, and I also missed the second mid-term test. What are my options for the end-semester exam?
If I register a week late and then pay my fees ten days after the due date, what will it cost me in total on top of the fees?
My CGPA dropped to 7.8 this semester and I got a warning for late entries at the hostel. Do I keep my merit scholarship?
I want to withdraw before classes start and I live in the hostel: what money do I get back, and by when?

borderline.question: Can I use a scientific calculator in the examination hall?
borderline.either: EE §2.1 permits listed items 'and any other item expressly permitted on the question paper'; 'only if the paper permits it' is a fair answer, 'not mentioned' is also fair

borderline.question: Will I get my hall ticket if my hostel fee is unpaid but my tuition fee is paid?
borderline.either: EE §1.2 lists the three conditions for a hall ticket positively; hostel dues are not one of them, so 'yes' is a strict reading, 'the rule speaks only of tuition dues' is a cautious one

borderline.question: Is the examination fee refunded if I withdraw from an exam?
borderline.either: FS §4.2 says the examination fee is not refundable after classes commence, a general sentence inside a section about withdrawing admission

answerable.question: What is the minimum attendance required to appear for the end-semester examination?
answerable.expected_answer: 75 per cent in each course

answerable.question: How are marks split between internal assessment and the end-semester exam for a theory course?
answerable.expected_answer: 40 internal, 60 end-semester

answerable.question: What is the minimum I need to score to pass a course?
answerable.expected_answer: 30 per cent in the end-semester exam and 40 per cent overall

answerable.question: What letter grade do I get for 85 marks?
answerable.expected_answer: A+ with 9 grade points

answerable.question: How many days do I have to apply for re-evaluation after results are declared?
answerable.expected_answer: 10 working days

answerable.question: What happens if I miss an end-semester exam because I was ill?
answerable.expected_answer: medical certificate within 5 working days; appear in the next supplementary as a first attempt without fee

answerable.question: What is the penalty if I am caught with a mobile phone in the exam hall?
answerable.expected_answer: treated as a first offence of unfair means: that paper cancelled, grade F

answerable.question: What time do the hostel gates close at night?
Can I use an induction cooktop in my hostel room?
answerable.expected_answer: No; confiscation and Rs. 1,000 fine

answerable.question: How much is the late fee if I pay my semester fees after the due date?
answerable.expected_answer: Rs. 100 per day, capped at Rs. 1,500

answerable.question: What is the last date to pay the odd semester tuition fee?
answerable.expected_answer: due 15 July 2026; last date with late fee 31 July 2026

answerable.question: Who is eligible for the merit-cum-means scholarship?
answerable.expected_answer: family income up to Rs. 3,00,000 and CGPA at least 7.0

answerable.question: Do I get leave if there is a death in my family?
answerable.expected_answer: up to 7 days bereavement leave counted as attendance, for parent, sibling, grandparent or spouse

answerable.question: Will I get my hall ticket if I have not paid my tuition fees?
answerable.expected_answer: No; hall ticket withheld until dues are cleared

answerable.question: How long can a break of study be?
answerable.expected_answer: one semester or one academic year, medical grounds only, once

answerable.question: What is the maximum time allowed to complete the B.Tech programme?
answerable.expected_answer: seven academic years

answerable.question: Can I get a mess rebate if I go home for two weeks?
answerable.expected_answer: yes, for absences of 7 days or more recorded in advance

answerable.question: How much medical insurance cover do students have?
answerable.expected_answer: hospitalisation up to Rs. 1,00,000 per year

answerable.question: How many credits do I need to earn to get my B.Tech degree?
answerable.expected_answer: 160 credits

answerable.question: What is the fee for a supplementary examination?
answerable.expected_answer: Rs. 800 per course

answerable.question: Within how many days are end-semester results declared?
answerable.expected_answer: within 30 days of the last examination

answerable.question: What happens on a third offence of unfair means in an examination?
answerable.expected_answer: expulsion from the Institute

answerable.question: What CGPA do I need to stand for the Student Council election?
answerable.expected_answer: not less than 6.5, no F or DT grade, not on probation, no disciplinary action

answerable.question: How much campaign money can a candidate spend in the council election?
How many students are needed to register a new club?
answerable.expected_answer: at least fifteen

answerable.question: How far in advance must a club apply for permission to hold an event?
answerable.expected_answer: at least ten working days

answerable.question: How long do I get to reply to a show-cause notice from the disciplinary committee?
answerable.expected_answer: not less than five working days

answerable.question: By when must the grievance cell decide on my complaint?
answerable.expected_answer: acknowledged within 3 working days, decided within 15 working days

answerable.question: Can I appeal a disciplinary committee decision, and to whom?
answerable.expected_answer: to the Vice-Chancellor within 7 days

answerable.question: Is there a charge for booking the auditorium for a club event?
answerable.expected_answer: free for Institute events; Rs. 5,000 refundable deposit if external participants
